name: donut_chart
description: A full-circle ring chart that displays a single metric as an animated filled arc. Great for fan speeds, temperatures, and other single-metric visualizations.

config.name: metric
config.label: Metric
config.description: The metric to display in the donut chart

config.name: max
config.label: Max Value
config.description: Override the maximum value for the arc. If not set, the max is automatically determined from the metric

config.name: thickness
config.label: Thickness
config.description: The width of the donut ring in pixels

config.name: corner_radius
config.label: Corner Radius
config.description: Rounds the ends of the donut arc. Set to 0 for flat edges

config.name: color
config.label: Color
config.description: The fill color of the donut arc

config.name: back_color
config.label: Back Color
config.description: The background color of the unfilled portion of the ring

config.name: warning_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: Percentage of max value at which the arc switches to the warning color

config.name: warning_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The arc color when the warning threshold is exceeded

config.name: critical_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: Percentage of max value at which the arc switches to the critical color

config.name: critical_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The arc color when the critical threshold is exceeded
